info.title: MatrixALM and MatrixQMS REST API
info.description: Feel free to make a copy of this definition and change the url below to your instance of MatrixALM or MatrixQMS. For the authentication, create  a token for an admin to try out all the methods. Use at your own risks! Any question? ask us on https://support.matrixreq.com

get.summary: Get list of all projects, all settings and current user, all todos and JIRA meta create object
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: adminUI
parameters.description: (optional) set to adminUI=1 to have all projects even the ones you are not assigned to, as an admin

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: (optional) comma-delimited list of requested output fields. Returns all fields if parameter is not present

post.summary: Creates a new project. Either the full project is sent as XML payload, or the label and shortLabel are given. If uploading data for a whole project, label and shortLabel are optional but overwrite the XML content if present. Branching can be done with an audit report as payload, and branch* must be defined in that case
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Must be set to yes if you're overwriting an existing project

parameters.name: importUsers
parameters.description: Must be set to yes if you want to import users. false by default

parameters.name: branchTag
parameters.description: Must be set to branch, and match a tag in the audit export (optional)

get.summary: Get a project's schema
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: excludeCategories
parameters.description: (optional) comma-separated list of categories to exclude, like DOC,SIGN

post.summary: Merge branch into mainline. First project is the mainline, second is the branch. The payload must contain a json object with a list of actions to perform.
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get list of project info -  users, settings, categories
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: adminUI
parameters.description: (optional) set to adminUI=1 to have this project data even if you are not assigned to, as an admin

post.summary: Adds a category to a project
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

delete.summary: Removes completely a project (only used for unit testing). This is an actual DELETE in the database.
delete.description: Permissions - Reserved to Matrix Requirements operations. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Needs to be yes for the method to be executed

get.summary: Retrieves all accesses in a project (list of groups and users who have access)
get.description: Permissions - Must have QMS viewer access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.2

get.summary: Retrieves all changes in a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: startAt
parameters.description: (optional) Pagination -  starts the audit after N records

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: (optional) Pagination -  Retrieve N results per page

parameters.name: deleteOnly
parameters.description: (optional) if set to yes, only returns actions of type delete

parameters.name: tech
parameters.description: (optional) if set to yes, returns the underneath changes

parameters.name: auditIdMin
parameters.description: (optional) sets a minimum ID for audits, as returned by GET calendar

parameters.name: auditIdMax
parameters.description: (optional) sets a maximum ID for audits

parameters.name: noReport
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to avoid having reports

parameters.name: noImport
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to avoid having imports

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: (optional) set to a list of actions to include (delete,undelete,add,edit,...)

parameters.name: resolveRef
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to resolve item IDs into refs

parameters.name: itemRef
parameters.description: (optional) restrict the audit to only those mentionning this item

post.summary: Launches a server-side branch or clone - needs the 'merge' module if actual branching
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: (optional) Set to 1 to branch (default), 0 to just copy/clone

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: (optional) Set to 1 to branch or copy with history, defaults to 0

parameters.name: branchInThePastTag
parameters.description: (optional) specify a tag to branch in the past (needs history=1)

parameters.name: keepPermissions
parameters.description: 1 or 0. Defaults to 0 (with 0 the project doesn't have any permission after branching)

parameters.name: keepContent
parameters.description: 1 or 0. Defaults to 1. 0 only works without branch and without history

get.summary: Get all dates at which a project has been modified
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: deleteOnly
parameters.description: (optional) if set to yes, only report actions of type delete

get.summary: Get all categories of a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Adds a fields in a category
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get details of a category
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

put.summary: Modifies a categorie's labels, and fix the project's settings to reflect that change, OR modifies a category's order.
put.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: shortLabel
parameters.description: The new short label for that category (for renaming)

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The new long label for that category (for renaming)

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

delete.summary: Removes (inactivate) a category. Will fail on REPORT and FOLDER categories
delete.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get all settings of a category
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Adds or changes a category setting. If the value is empty, the setting will be deleted
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Clones a project
post.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: keepContent
parameters.description: 1 or 0. Defaults to 0 (only the REPORT part is kept, make sense only if keepHistory is 0)

parameters.name: keepPermissions
parameters.description: 1 or 0. Defaults to 0 (with 0 the project doesn't have any permission after cloning)

post.summary: Asks for the difference between 2 signed documents, as a Word document. The job ID is returned as answer
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: signitem1
parameters.description: SIGN-xx for the first SIGN document to compare

parameters.name: signitem2
parameters.description: SIGN-xx for the 2nd SIGN document to compare

post.summary: Copy items from a folder to another one
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project - admins can impersonate. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: targetProject
parameters.description: (optional) project to copy into (by default, same project)

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: (optional) mapN=M -  map field N in source to field M in target

parameters.name: ignoreLabels
parameters.description: (optional) can contain a comma-delimited list of labels NOT to copy

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get cross project links
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Converts an excel file (xls, xlsx) into a XML version that we send straight back as an XML payload.
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Executes UC or TC into XTC items
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

requestBody.description: There must be a JSON as a payload. It includes all parameters AND the reason

get.summary: Asks for an export of some items. The job ID is returned as answer
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: itemList
parameters.description: Mandatory list of items to export.

put.summary: Modifies a field's label and parameter OR modifies a field's order.
put.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

delete.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get 1 field of an item. {item} has the form CATEG-number.
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Mandatory. Field number (faster) OR field label

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional. Format for the return. Can be text, json, html, xml or xslt. Defaults to html

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Optional. 1 to have in download, 0 as direct result. Defaults to 0.

get.summary: Retrieve list of all files owned by a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Creates a new file - the file should be uploaded as payload (or through the url argument as an alternative). It's mime type should be sent through the HTTP protocol.
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Optional argument -  the file could also come from an external URL. In this case there will be an error if we can't retrieve it on the server

get.summary: Retrieve one project file. The fileno is a simple fileId. This request returns the actual file
get.description: Permissions - Must have the right key to download the file. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: (optional, from version 2.3) set to disposition=inline to ask the server to send the disposition to 'inline' instead of 'attachment'

post.summary: Creates a new folder
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project - admins can impersonate. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Reference of the parent folder in the form F-CATEG-serial (example -  F-SPEC-17)

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

parameters.name: fxField
parameters.description: (optional) Add one of each of these to set folder's fields. fx is followed by the field ID (a number)

put.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

post.summary: Launches a server-side hook
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.2

requestBody.description: Payload for the hook, treated as a string.

post.summary: Cleans up an input html blob according to the current html cleanup rules. The blob is passed in the POST payload. The payload must be a json object with {"htmlToClean" - "x"}
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

post.summary: Get the list of items that would be changed if we applied html cleanup. You can pass a cleanup setting in the payload of the POST. If it's not there we take the customer (global) setting and force the cleanup to true
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: (optional) list of comma-delimited categories to go through, all by default

post.summary: Imports some items into a project
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get the history of a import in a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.4

post.summary: Adds an item in a folder
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project - admins can impersonate. Valid from version 2.1

get.summary: Get details of a folder. {folder} has the form F-CATEG-number[-vN].
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: (optional) set history=1 to retrieve list of all versions

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: (optional) set to yes if you need the children as well (recursively).

parameters.name: atDate
parameters.description: (optional) retrieves the item at that date - format is ISO8601 like atDate=2018-05-30T14 - 48 - 27.223Z. Not compatible with the version query -vN

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: (optional) set fields=1 to retrieve list of all fields, even the empty ones

get.summary: Get details of an item. {item} has the form CATEG-number[-vN].
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: (optional) set history=1 to retrieve list of all versions

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: (optional) set fields=1 to retrieve list of all fields, even the empty ones

parameters.name: atDate
parameters.description: (optional) retrieves the item at that date - format is ISO8601 like atDate=2018-05-30T14 - 48 - 27.223Z. Not compatible with the version query -vN

parameters.name: withTree
parameters.description: (optional) retrieves the context tree if set to 1, in the field contextTree. Exclusive to filter and atDate

put.summary: Modifies an item or a folder. Item has the form CATEG-number, folders -  F-CATEG-number
put.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Restores an item. Item has the form CATEG-number
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: (optional) If set, specifies that the item should be restored as it was in that version

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

delete.summary: Removes (inactivate) an item (or a folder). Item has the form (F-)CATEG-number. Will fail on non-empty folders
delete.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Needs to be yes for the method to be executed IF it is a non-empty folder

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

post.summary: Adds a link between 2 items. Both items are in the form CATEG-number
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: upitem
parameters.description: Item reference (XXX-nn) for the UP item

parameters.name: downitem
parameters.description: Item reference (XXX-nn) for the DOWN item

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

delete.summary: Removes (inactivate) a link between 2 items. Items are in the form CATEG-number

parameters.name: upitem
parameters.description: Item reference (XXX-nn) for the UP item

parameters.name: downitem
parameters.description: Item reference (XXX-nn) for the DOWN item

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get the list of items that are detailed in a DOC/SIGN item.
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Optional. When set to 1 adds a secondaryItems list in the answer. Defaults to 0.

get.summary: Retrieve list of all jobs in a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

get.summary: Get a job status, including generated files. The variable part is the jobID (a number)
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Sets the progress of a job
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.2

delete.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get a job file. The job part is the jobID (a number) and the file is the fileID (a number)
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: (optional) set to mode=direct to get the output in the response output instead of as a download file. This assumes the file is HTML

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: (optional) set to format=json to get a json output instead of XML

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: (optional, from version 2.3) set to disposition=inline to ask the server to send the disposition to 'inline' instead of 'attachment'

get.summary: Get the label history of a project -  list of all label changes for all items
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: itemRef
parameters.description: (optional) ask for just one item (the return structure is still an array in that case)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: (optional) date to - works only if you only specified a from

get.summary: Get the merge history of a project - needs the 'merge' module
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

get.summary: Get the merge information - needs the 'merge' module
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: excludeCategories
parameters.description: (optional) comma-delimited list of categories to exclude

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: (optional) date from which we consider the merges. ISO8601 format -- this parameter was introduced in v 2.3.4

parameters.name: push
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 if you inquire about a push, not a merge -- this parameter was introduced in v 2.3.4

post.summary: Imports some folders from a project to another as a module. Only available is you have the compose module licensed
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Import mode -  can be include or copy

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: Update mode -  can be simple, update or rebase. If not defined, simple assumed

parameters.name: sourceSelection
parameters.description: A selection of folders and items to import

parameters.name: lockLabel
parameters.description: An optional label that this operation will set on all items

parameters.name: itemParentMode
parameters.description: Default 'orphan'. Specify 'preserve' to include all parent folders to the root

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

post.summary: Move items into this folder
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: List of items to move in

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Use POST verb instead. Find items based on a search string in one project
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: search id. Used by MatrixJira js to match queries with answers. Is returned in the output structure

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: (optional) applies a filter, can be negative

parameters.name: fieldsOut
parameters.description: (optional) comma-delimited list of fields to return -  101,102 - or * for all

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to return labels in the output

parameters.name: treeOrder
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to return items in tree order (otherwise it's project,category,serial)

parameters.name: links
parameters.description: (optional) set to up,down to return up and down items, or only up or only down

post.summary: Find items based on a search string in one project
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.4

get.summary: Find item ids based on a search string in one project
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: (optional) applies a filter, can be negative

post.summary: Find item ids based on a search string in one project
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.4

post.summary: Publishes an item. Item has the form PUB-nnn
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: trainingFor
parameters.description: (optional) list of items for which we need to add training. If list is not there, all trainings will be generated

get.summary: Find a string in the QMS published items
get.description: Permissions - Must have QMS viewer access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.3

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: (optional) search term. Return an empty array on PUB < 2.3.1 and et the list of all pub if not specified.

parameters.name: pubItem
parameters.description: (optional) PUB-x item if you want to search in another than the last one for that project

post.summary: Asks for a new report. The job ID is returned as answer. {report} can be REPORT-n, DOC-n, SIGN-n or a report name.To follow the progress of the job, the GET /{project}/job/{jobid} can be called
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) for the reports, read/write for the signed reports. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: itemList
parameters.description: (optional) list of items to use in the report. By default all categories are used

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: (optional) url to generate in the filter

parameters.name: resturl
parameters.description: (optional) REST url to generate in the filter

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: (optional) format -  html (default), pdf, docx, odt, xml, zipdocx, zippdf or package (from 2.2), or mf (since 2.3)

parameters.name: isSignedReport
parameters.description: If set to true, means the report needs to generate a signed record

parameters.name: includeSignatures
parameters.description: List of comma separated users who need to sign

parameters.name: newTitle
parameters.description: New title for the SIGN- item that is generated (only valid for isSignedReport)

parameters.name: copyFields
parameters.description: List of from-to fields (123,456),(124,457) that we can use to generate the fields in the SIGN record (only valid for isSignedReport)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: (optional) specify a comma-delimited filter list. Can be negative filters (with minus before)

parameters.name: useOld
parameters.description: (optional) ask to use the old report engine (pre 1.11) if set to 1.

parameters.name: atDate
parameters.description: (optional) generates the report at that date - format is ISO8601 like atDate=2018-05-30T14 - 48 - 27.223Z

parameters.name: reportNameOverride
parameters.description: (optional) Allow to override the reportName of the provided document

get.summary: Get a project's schema
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: simple
parameters.description: (optional) set to simple=1 to have a simpler output (no fields, round shape)

parameters.name: excludeCategories
parameters.description: (optional) comma-separated list of categories to exclude, like DOC,SIGN

get.summary: Get all settings of a project
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Adds or changes a project setting. If the value is empty, the setting will be deleted.
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

put.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: rejectSign
parameters.description: The reason why the user is rejecting the signature

post.summary: Signs an item. Item has the form SIGN-nnn
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: signature password - the user who is signing is the one who is logged in

post.summary: Asks for a new report. The job ID is returned as answer
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: (optional) url to generate in the filter

parameters.name: resturl
parameters.description: (optional) REST url to generate in the filter

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: (optional) format -  html (default), pdf, docx, odt, xml, zipdocx or zippdf

get.summary: Get all tags of a project. Works on any project if user is admin
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

post.summary: Adds a tag to a project
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Tag label. Must be unique within a project

parameters.name: auditId
parameters.description: Id of the audit this tag is based on

get.summary: Get all todos for the current user, for oneproject
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: itemRef
parameters.description: (optional) set to an item to have all todos linked to an item, regardless of the user

parameters.name: includeDone
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to include done todos and todo's created by the user

parameters.name: includeAllUsers
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to include all todos for all users

parameters.name: includeFuture
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to include future todos as well (defaults to 0)

post.summary: Creates a todo on an item (note that you only need read access for this POST method) for you or others
post.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: fieldId
parameters.description: (optional) If set, specifies that the todo is related to that field (review, ...)

parameters.name: logins
parameters.description: (optional) If set, a list of user logins or groups to which these todo apply

parameters.name: atDate
parameters.description: (optional) a date in the future for reminders

parameters.name: auto
parameters.description: (optional) set to 1 to create an auto-notification (0 by default)

delete.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: hardDelete
parameters.description: Set to yes to actually remove the record

put.summary: Touches (set to same date) an item or folder
put.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

get.summary: Get full tree
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: atDate
parameters.description: (optional) generates the tree at that date - format is ISO8601 like atDate=2018-05-30T14 - 48 - 27.223Z

put.description: Permissions - Must be admin. Valid from version 2.2

parameters.name: newShort
parameters.description: The new project short name to use

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

post.summary: Converts a word document to an HTML, with images pointing to uploaded files on the server
post.description: Permissions - Must have read/write access to the project. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: fileNo
parameters.description: If specified, means that the conversion is from an already uploaded file. Otherwise the file must be uploaded as body of this call

parameters.name: targetDocumentFolder
parameters.description: target document folder (in this case creates a document)

parameters.name: useAsField
parameters.description: set to 1 to have this docx used as a field. In this case the return value is the html equivalent, with some meta

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: The reason why the user is doing this

post.summary: Asks for the difference between A and B html exerpts, and produce the B html with annotations
post.description: Permissions - No permissions needed. Valid from version 2.1

get.summary: Returns all info about a date
get.description: Permissions - Must have a valid authentication. Valid from version 2.1

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: (optional) an input date formatted as iso8601. If not present, current date/time is used

parameters.name: dateformat
parameters.description: (optional) a date formatter. If not present, current date format is used

parameters.name: timeformat
parameters.description: (optional) a date-time formatter. If not present, current date/time format is used

get.summary: Retrieve list of all customer-wide files
get.description: Permissions - Must have read access (or higher) to the project. Valid from version 2.1
